verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a reasonable feature for a domain registrar, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an MCP server that lets external agents such as Cursor or Claude Desktop call the API, plus a read-only docs MCP server. Those are integrations for outside agents, not an assistant inside name.com to which a user can delegate tasks, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
